evidence: backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/integrations/install.rs:1675-1687 (create portal connection handler) — base_url = std::env::var("API_BASE_URL").unwrap_or_else(|_| "https://api.ppt.example.com".to_string()), then webhook_url = format!("{}/api/v1/integrations/webhooks/portal/{}", base_url, connection_id) is returned in the 201 PortalConnectionResponse and published to the external portal provider (sreality/bezrealitky/immowelt/custom) as the endpoint they must POST webhooks to. If API_BASE_URL is unset or misconfigured in ANY environment, every portal install silently hands out a webhook URL on the placeholder/example domain api.ppt.example.com — an operator-unowned host. Consequences: (a) inbound portal webhooks never reach api-server (integration silently broken, no error surfaced to the installer); (b) api.ppt.example.com is registerable by a third party, so a misconfigured deploy could direct real portal webhook deliveries — which the portal_webhooks receiver expects to carry HMAC-signed, tenant-scoped payloads — to an attacker-controllable endpoint. Should fail closed (reject/500 CONFIG_ERROR) when API_BASE_URL is unset rather than defaulting to an example domain, mirroring the fail-closed secret handling already used for the *_WEBHOOK_SECRET env vars (portal_webhooks.rs get_portal_webhook_secret, #2263).

backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/ai/voice.rs:189-197 (exchange_voice_oauth_tokens) — redirect_uri is read via std::env::var("ALEXA_REDIRECT_URI") / std::env::var("GOOGLE_VOICE_REDIRECT_URI").unwrap_or_else(|_| "https://ppt.three-two-bit.com/api/v1/webhooks/voice/oauth/callback".to_string()), hardcoding the production host as the fallback. The OAuth spec requires the redirect_uri sent in the code->token exchange (oauth_manager.exchange_code at :200) to byte-match the one used in the authorize step. On any non-prod environment (staging / worktree *.dev / local) where the platform-specific REDIRECT_URI env var is not set, the exchange falls back to the prod URI, so it mismatches the authorize-step URI and the provider rejects the exchange — voice-device OAuth linking silently fails on every non-prod deploy with only a generic OAUTH_EXCHANGE_FAILED surfaced. Should derive the fallback from the same API_BASE_URL/host config the rest of the server uses, or fail closed when unset, rather than baking in ppt.three-two-bit.com.
